name: 29654 · Honea Path, SC
findings: ZIP 29654 (Honea Path) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29654 (Honea Path) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
